pencereler.0-5: This gas kills people in their sleep, with no warning. Carbon monoxide has no
pencereler.5-12: color, no smell, and no taste. It comes from anything that burns fuel - heaters, cars, stoves. Your blood
pencereler.12-20: grabs onto it two hundred times easier than oxygen. So your body suffocates even in a room full of air. The first
pencereler.20-30: signs feel exactly like being tired or having flu. People fall asleep and simply never wake up. A cheap detector is the only thing that can warn you.
